verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a hardware security key, for example whether stored keys, OTP secrets or passwords can be exported or backed up. The pack documents no export of user data in open formats. The open-source firmware and the nitropy CLI are adjacent openness traits, not a data-export capability. The community-mentioned HSM key escrow paper backup is a single anecdote about a different model, with no open-format detail.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
